dedupe_keys.name: ine spain census 2021 population on the european 1 km grid with grid cell boundaries

description: As part of the 2021 census, INE publishes the resident population of Spain counted in the cells of the European 1 km grid. Each row is a cell identified by its GRD_ID in the ETRS89 Lambert azimuthal equal-area system (EPSG:3035) and gives total population, men and women, three age groups (under 16, 16 to 64, over 64), Spanish and foreign nationals, four education levels and economic activity (active, inactive). A zipped shapefile gives the outline of the cells. INE produces it with the census so that population can be mapped on cells that do not change with administrative boundaries. Coverage: all populated cells of Spain. Format and access: CSV and XLSX tables and a shapefile, free without registration from the census results page. Licence: CC BY 4.0 under INE's legal notice. Caveats: counts appear rounded to multiples of five in the rows read, the CSV uses semicolons, a dot as thousands separator and Latin-1 characters in its two header rows, and there are no dwelling counts on the grid. Simulation uses: population exposure to floods, fires and heat on a regular grid, and allocation of demand for service and evacuation models. Related records: the INE census section indicators, the Zensus 2022 grid for Germany, GHSL and WorldPop.
